title: cubacle run options
description: How much to compute. Run options never change the pattern. The names are the command line options without dashes, in camel case; budgetMs is the REST name of the time budget.

limit.description: Print at most this many states. Default 20.

seed.description: Seed of the draw for sample.

maxStates.description: Hard cap on the enumeration. Default 50000000.

maxDepth.description: Depth limit of the move search; only with solve.
